AccordionRoot.description: Holds which items are open and shares it with the items inside it.

props.value: The values of the open items. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the accordion.
props.defaultValue: The values of the items open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new list of open values when a trigger asks to open or close an item, and after the browser opened one by itself for find-in-page. A controlled accordion follows `value`.
props.multiple: Whether several items can be open at once. Without it the items share a `name`, and the browser closes the open item when another opens.
props.orientation: Which arrow keys move focus between triggers: Up and Down when `vertical`, Left and Right when `horizontal`.
props.loopFocus: Whether the arrow keys wrap from the last trigger to the first and back.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the accordion is disabled.

AccordionItem.description: One item: a `<details>` element holding a trigger and a panel. Style it with `[open]`.

props.value: Identifies the item in the root's `value`. Without it the item gets a generated value.
props.disabled: Whether the item is disabled: its trigger ignores presses and keys, leaves the tab order and is skipped by the arrow keys. Find-in-page still opens it.
props.onOpenChange: Called when the item is asked to open or close, before the root's `onValueChange`.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item, or the whole accordion, is disabled.

AccordionTrigger.description: The `<summary>` that opens and closes its item. It must be the item's first child; put a heading inside it rather than around it. A press asks the root rather than toggling the element, so a controlled `value` decides.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item, or the whole accordion, is disabled.

AccordionPanel.description: The item's content, hidden by the browser while the item is closed. It has the `region` role and is labelled by its trigger. Its measured size is written to CSS variables for animating its height.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item, or the whole accordion, is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-ending-style: Present while the panel animates out. The item stays open until the panel's transitions and animations finish.

cssVariables.--accordion-panel-height: The panel's content height: in px while it opens and closes, `auto` once it is open.
cssVariables.--accordion-panel-width: The panel's content width: in px while it opens and closes, `auto` once it is open.
